theme: Goal-based investing: education, retirement, home, wedding funds
headline: Align Your Investments With Your Life Goals
body: Different goals need different timelines. Match your investment approach to when you'll need the money.
caption: Whether saving for education, retirement, a home, or a wedding, time horizon shapes your investment strategy. Starting early gives your money more time to work. #GoalBasedInvesting #TimeHorizon #LongTermWealth #SmartMoney #InvestmentStrategy
